seoTitle: Metro Nashville Public Schools Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates
seoDescription: MNPS begins Aug. 11, 2026. See fall, Thanksgiving, winter and spring breaks, grade-specific half days, quarter dates, official PDFs and calendar downloads.
heroSummary: The 2026–27 MNPS school year begins Tuesday, August 11, 2026. Grades 1–12 attend full days on August 11 and 12, while Pre-K and kindergarten have half days. Fall Break is October 12–16, Thanksgiving break is November 23–27, and students are out for Winter Break beginning December 21. Spring Break is March 22–25, followed by the Spring Holiday on March 26. The last day of school is Tuesday, May 25, 2027, with a half-day schedule for all students.

verificationBadgeText: Last checked August 20, 2026 against the official MNPS district calendar and translated editions.
calendarNotes: Grades 1–12 attend full days on August 11 and 12; Pre-K and kindergarten attend half days on both dates. On December 15–17 and May 20–21 and 24, only grades 9–12 have half-day exam schedules; Pre-K–8 attend full days. December 18, March 19, and May 25 are half days for all students. The Thanksgiving and Winter student holidays are longer than the district-office closures inside them. The English calendar does not name specific potential snow make-up dates, while the Burmese, Somali, and Swahili editions do; no candidate date is included as a confirmed event or in the ICS.

customSections.label: How the MNPS Opening Schedule Works
customSections.content: August 11 is the first student day, but the length of the day depends on grade. The same schedule applies on August 12.

table.caption: MNPS 2026–27 opening attendance
table.footnote: The annual PDF does not list a single districtwide dismissal time for the Pre-K and kindergarten half days. Check with your school or Pre-K program for the dismissal time.

customSections.label: Not Every MNPS Half Day Applies to Every Grade
customSections.content: MNPS separates high school exam half days from districtwide half days. Pre-K–8 students attend a full day on those exam dates.

customSections.label: Student Breaks and MNPS Office Closures
customSections.content: Students may be out of school even when MNPS offices remain open. During Thanksgiving and Winter Break, MNPS lists shorter office-closure periods inside the longer student breaks; March 26 is a separate Spring Holiday when schools and offices are closed.

customSections.label: MNPS Snow Make-Up Days: What “Stockpiled” Means
customSections.content: MNPS lists six stockpiled professional-development days and seven stockpiled inclement-weather days, but that does not mean seven extra school closures are already scheduled. The English calendar does not give a fixed make-up sequence. Three translated editions—Burmese, Somali, and Swahili—also list February 15, May 28, and June 1–4 and 7 as possible make-up dates. We do not treat those dates as school days unless MNPS activates them.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from the 2025–26 MNPS Calendar?
whatsNew.subtitle: The opening, breaks, final day, and stockpiled-day totals all shifted.
content: The first student day moves from August 5, 2025, to August 11, 2026. Both calendars begin with full days for grades 1–12 and half days for Pre-K and kindergarten.
Fall Break moves from October 13–17 to October 12–16. Thanksgiving moves from November 24–28 to November 23–27.
Students return from Winter Break on January 5, 2027, one day earlier on the calendar than the January 6 return in 2026.
The final student day moves from May 21, 2026, to May 25, 2027; both dates are half days for all students.
The printed totals change from seven stockpiled PD days and six stockpiled inclement-weather days to six PD days and seven inclement-weather days.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Metro Nashville Public Schools start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day is Tuesday, August 11, 2026. Grades 1–12 attend full days on August 11 and 12, while Pre-K and kindergarten attend half days on both dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When do MNPS students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21–31, 2026. January 1 is a district-closed holiday and January 4 is a stockpiled professional-development day, so students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MNPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The annual MNPS calendar lists Spring Break for March 22–25, 2027, followed by a separate Spring Holiday on March 26. The district's live calendar groups March 22–26 under Spring Break. Students are out all five days and return Monday, March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: Are December and May exam half days for all MNPS students?
calendarFaqs.a: Not all of them. December 15–17 and May 20–21 and 24 are half days only for grades 9–12 exams; Pre-K–8 attend full days. December 18 and May 25 are half days for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for MNPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Tuesday, May 25, 2027 is the last student day. It is a half day for all students, and grades 9–12 have exams.

calendarFaqs.q: Does MNPS have scheduled snow make-up days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Not as fixed make-up days. The English calendar does not give a set make-up sequence. MNPS lists six stockpiled professional-development days and seven stockpiled inclement-weather days. The Burmese, Somali, and Swahili editions also list February 15, May 28, and June 1–4 and 7 as possible make-up dates. None is treated as a school day unless MNPS activates it.

sourceReviewSummary: This page uses the official English district calendar as the primary source, with the Arabic, Burmese, Kurdish, Somali, Spanish, and Swahili editions checked for calendar structure and source differences.
sourceReviewDetails: Checked the full one-page layout, month grids, date list, attendance colors, and calendar key in all seven official editions.
The English calendar was revised February 9, 2026, and serves as the source for the event table and ICS.

The Burmese, Somali, and Swahili editions additionally list February 15, May 28, and June 1–4 and 7 as potential snow make-up dates; the English, Arabic, Kurdish, and Spanish editions use general wording.
Potential make-up dates are not treated as confirmed school days and are excluded from the ICS until MNPS activates them.

The annual PDF labels March 22–25 as Spring Break and March 26 as a separate Spring Holiday; the live calendar groups March 22–26 under Spring Break. Both sources show that students are out all five days.
The annual calendar does not list a single districtwide dismissal time for half days or an instructional-day total, so neither is inferred.
